items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we started a band called Sawbuck with a singer – we found a singer named Sky Ford. He was a killer – and Link. ... Vicari came in, or was he there at the beginning? I forget. And eventually Pee Wee.

ctx.x: Because Jimmy was very close with Enrico.
That was the first time I – I had heard you before, but I had never heard Enrico and Vicari and Link before. That was a real revelation.
